name: Second Order Pre-Integrated Volume Rendering
aliases: 2nd order Newton-Cotes integration for volume rendering
definition: A volume rendering method that approximates the scalar field along a ray segment using a 2nd order Lagrange polynomial (quadratic) defined by three equispaced samples, allowing for pre-computation of the volume rendering integral into a lookup table to capture high-frequency transfer function details more accurately than linear (1st order) interpolation.
